messages:
elaine: quick check-in: I pushed a migration guide draft for quota/dashboard changes (docs/pricing/quota-migration-guide.md). needs review for accuracy and a short SDK snippet for Go.
marco: link?
elaine: https://staging.redwood-inference.dev/docs/pr/421 (preview image + YAML frontmatter included)
priya: skimmed. high-level looks good. two requests: 1) clarify that rate limits (RPS) and quota windows (tokens/month) are orthogonal; 2) unify examples to use tokens throughout
cj: +1 on orthogonal note. ops teams trip on RPS vs tokens. maybe add a tiny diagram? even ascii is fine.
elaine: added a 3-line ASCII timeline showing rolling window and RPS spikes. will push.
nina: Go snippet quick drop: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{Prompt: "hi"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
remaining := resp.Headers.Get("X-Remaining-Tokens")
fmt.Println("remaining:", remaining)
```
priya: perfect. also let's include an explicit header reference row for X-Quota-Reset and X-Tier-Allocated (we currently have X-Quota-Window-End but some SDKs surface different names)
marco: small nit: our backend returns X-Quota-Window-End in RFC3339. can we call that out so docs parsers know format?
elaine: added note: "X-Quota-Window-End: RFC3339 timestamp for end of rolling window"
cj: For the dashboard migration section: your screenshot points to /dash/v1/old-usage-panel. please change to the new panel slug /dash/usage/tiers. otherwise LGTM
elaine: thanks, will update image link to assets/quota-new-panel.png
priya: copy nit: under "tier promotion" we wrote "customer moves up slab"  replace slab -> tier across doc (we've had external confusion)
elaine: replaced all slab -> tier. grep/replace done.
marco: also add a brief calc example for prorated charge on mid-window upgrade: e.g., allocated 500k tokens, user upgrades to 1M on day 10 of 30 -> prorated allocated = 1M * (20/30) + 500k * (10/30) ??? need product math check
priya: product math is: effective allocation = weighted by time at each tier during the 30-day window. Example: 10 days at 500k + 20 days at 1M -> (500k*10 + 1M*20)/30 = 833,333 tokens effective allocation. add an overage calc after that
cj: add a short curl sample for SREs to validate headers: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/status
# check X-Tier-Allocated, X-Remaining-Tokens, X-Quota-Window-End
```
docs-bot: checklist: header table updated, Go + JS + Python snippets included, image moved to assets. :white_check_mark:
preview-bot: preview published: https://staging.redwood-inference.dev/docs/pr/421/preview (expires in 48h)
elaine: ok will wait 30m for any more comments then merge. tagging for final tech review: @priya @marco @cj
priya: will do a quick pass after merge for tone.
marco: will push the panel slug change and a tiny change to the YAML frontmatter (add breadcrumbs).
elaine: thanks all. merging in 30m if no blockers. :rocket:
